description: This file provides utility functions for parsing and retrieving cgroup parameters, including handling errors and deprecated functions, within the 'fscommon' package.

classes.name: ParseError
classes.description: Struct representing an error encountered during parsing cgroup data, including file path, filename, and underlying error.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message string for ParseError.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the underlying error for ParseError.

methods.name: ParseUint
methods.description: Converts a string to uint64, handling negative values due to kernel bugs by returning zero.

methods.name: ParseKeyValue
methods.description: Parses a 'key value' string into key and uint64 value.

methods.name: GetValueByKey
methods.description: Reads a cgroup file and retrieves the value associated with a specific key.

methods.name: GetCgroupParamUint
methods.description: Reads a uint64 parameter from a cgroup file, returning max if 'max' is read.

methods.name: GetCgroupParamInt
methods.description: Reads an int64 parameter from a cgroup file, returning max if 'max' is read.

methods.name: GetCgroupParamString
methods.description: Reads a string value from a cgroup file.
